name: JE_GR_TRNOVR_RULE_LINES
description: JE_GR_TRNOVR_RULE_LINES contains the detailed exemption clauses that identify which transactions will be excluded by the Greek Turnover extraction program under a specific exclusion rule  set for the AR and AP applications. This table corresponds to the  Detail part of the Define Turnover Exclusion Rules window .

columns.name: TRNOVR_RULE_LINE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each exclusion rule line created

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Identifier which indicates the application to which the groups belong

columns.name: TRNOVR_RULE_ID
columns.description: Unique ID for each exclusion rule created

columns.name: LOOKUP_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the turnover group

columns.name: LOOKUP_CODE
columns.description: Group identifier of the parent group being included

columns.name: EXCLUDE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag which indicates if the group is included or excluded

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
